coordinates.formula: Exact same-month YoY: 100*(level(t)/level(t-12 months)-1). Standardize each against its prior 120 calendar months inclusive, population SD; minimum 96 valid YoY pairs with full returned span. Equally average two standardized components per axis.
coordinates.meaning: Relative current-vintage year-over-year rates, not growth acceleration, a certified business-cycle phase, recession odds or asset leadership. Missing reference months are excluded and counted, never shifted or interpolated.

dependency_graph.interpretation: Shared explicitly declared FRED identities expose possible repeated evidence. Root discovery is incomplete for legacy packets and does not prove source independence, upstream calculation validity or synchronized vintages. Publication age is not observation freshness.

net_liquidity_proxy.formula: WALCL/1000 - WTREGEN/1000 - RRPONTSYD, USD billions; change compares exactly 91 calendar days.
net_liquidity_proxy.meaning: A named balance-sheet proxy, not total market liquidity, reserves, money available for equities, easing or a portfolio forecast. No missing leg is zero; a future first observation is never carried backward.
net_liquidity_proxy.temporal_basis: WALCL is a Wednesday level; WTREGEN is a week average with matching reported date; RRP is the latest reported date on or before that date, maximum 7 calendar days. These are mixed period measures, not synchronized stocks.

portfolio_consequences.bond_formula: -signed DV01 USD per basis point * entered yield change basis points
portfolio_consequences.equity_formula: signed USD equity exposure * entered price return percent / 100

unemployment_rule.formula: Mean U3(t,t-1,t-2) minus minimum of the twelve three-month means ending t-12 through t-1; exact consecutive reference months.
unemployment_rule.label: Reconstruction from currently retained unemployment history
unemployment_rule.meaning: A descriptive unemployment rule. The reconstruction uses the current UNRATE vintage, not the unemployment data available in each past month. The official real-time series can differ. Threshold crossing does not establish a recession probability or portfolio trade.
